name: Growlithe
flavor: A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
firstNightReminder: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.

name: Klink
flavor: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
ability: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.

name: Audino
flavor: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.
ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

name: Minccino
flavor: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
firstNightReminder: Minccino chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
otherNightReminder: Minccino chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.

name: Smeargle
flavor: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

name: Mimikyu
flavor: There will be no forgiveness for any who reveal that it was pretending to be Pikachu. It will bring the culprit down, even at the cost of its own life.
ability: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed Mimikyu, wake Mimikyu and point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.

name: Spinda
flavor: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.
ability: You do not know you are Spinda. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

name: Trubbish
flavor: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.
ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.

name: Gothitelle
flavor: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe’s end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

jinxes.reason: If there would be two Demons, one of which was Gothitelle, Gothitelle becomes Gothitelle again.
If there would be two Demons, one of which was Gothitelle, Gothitelle remains as Gothitelle.

ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
otherNightReminder: If Gothitelle became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

name: Honchkrow
flavor: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

name: Darkrai
flavor: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes Darkrai.
otherNightReminder: Darkrai chooses a player. :reminder: If Darkrai chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Darkrai token. Put the old Darkrai to sleep. Wake the new Darkrai. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Darkrai token.

name: Pokémania
ability: Every character is a Pokémon! No changes have been made to character abilities.
